items.title: Amazon MSK Express brokers available on AWS Graviton4-based M8g instances
items.summary: Amazon MSK Express brokers are now available on AWS Graviton4-based M8g instances. Compared with Express on M7g, M8g delivers 15% lower broker-hour pricing, lower P99 produce latency, faster consumer recovery, a new 24xlarge size, and no broker-side charge for cross-AZ client traffic.
items.creator: Charishma Makineni
categories: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
